findings: No-Any scope misses the live robot envelope module.
Pydantic and JSON Schema drift is not pinned to one authority.
Validation scope can miss public envelope/output changes.
Manifest/frontmatter typing is underspecified across source and projection contracts.
improvement_opportunities: Add envelope.py to the no-Any ban scope.
Define one canonical parity rule between Pydantic models and JSON Schemas.
Name one exact validation entrypoint and fail closed on unknown scopes.
Split source frontmatter and manifest projection into separate contracts.
strengths: The spec already acknowledges the real risk surfaces: status, receipts, lockfiles, and visual artifacts.
It correctly keeps live project mutation out of scope.
validation_evidence: Read Infrastructure/scripts/lib/ask/skills_sdk/typed_contracts.py and the matching JSON Schemas.
next_action: Revise the PU-011 spec to close the listed contract/runtime gaps before implementation planning.
